findings.title: Data Moat Inflation
findings.gap_ref: The queryable corpus is 58 enriched listings across three agencies (Agency A, Agency B, Agency C) in SQLite + ChromaDB
findings.detail: The core value proposition relies on a multi-agency data moat, yet evidence only supports one of the three promised agencies. This discrepancy suggests the product's scale and competitive advantage are significantly overstated.
findings.action: Provide verifiable ingestion logs or database snapshots proving the presence of Agency A and Agency B datasets.

findings.title: Legal Entity Uncertainty
findings.gap_ref: Registration secured for Startup OLÉ Marbella
findings.detail: Claiming business registration is complete without providing legal documentation is a major red flag for institutional investment. Without a verified legal entity, there is no legitimate vehicle for equity or contract enforcement.
findings.action: Submit the official commercial registry certificate for Startup OLÉ Marbella immediately.

findings.title: Uncontrolled Scope Creep
findings.gap_ref: Adversarial Watcher — staged intention-vs-implementation gap pipeline
findings.detail: The presence of undocumented, uncommitted features like the 'Adversarial Watcher' indicates a lack of roadmap discipline. This 'shadow development' makes it impossible to assess true progress against the agreed-upon milestones.
findings.action: Perform a full audit of the current codebase against the original roadmap to identify all uncommitted technical debt and features.

findings.title: Undocumented Architectural Volatility
findings.gap_ref: swap Reducer model from qwen3.5:35b to gemma4:26b
findings.detail: Unannounced shifts in the core model architecture suggest technical instability and a lack of transparency regarding performance and cost implications. Such changes can fundamentally alter the product's unit economics without investor awareness.
findings.action: Require a technical impact assessment for all model swaps, including latency and cost-per-token changes.

summary: The startup is exhibiting significant 'narrative inflation,' where the technical and commercial reality is much narrower than the documented claims. I cannot verify the existence of the core data moat or the legal foundation of the business, presenting unacceptable risk to capital deployment.
